# auoraa — AI Portfolio Builder & Developer Resume to Website

> auoraa is an AI-powered visual web development platform that converts software developer resumes (PDF, DOCX, TXT, or Google Drive) into recruiter-ready, responsive, interactive web portfolios in under 30 seconds.

## Website & Links
- Website: https://portfolio-builder-six-jet.vercel.app/
- Public Portfolios: https://portfolio-builder-six-jet.vercel.app/p/:username/:portfolioId
- Pricing: https://portfolio-builder-six-jet.vercel.app/#pricing
- Privacy Policy: https://portfolio-builder-six-jet.vercel.app/privacy
- Source Code & GitHub: https://github.com/2411Aditya/Portfolio-Builder

## Key Capabilities & Features
- **Neural Semantic Resume Parsing**: Automatically extracts candidate name, title, bio, technical skills, employment history, featured projects, certifications, and contact details from uploaded resumes or Google Drive.
- **10 Modular Designer Templates**:
  1. *Minimal*: Clean typography-driven portfolio with dark and light canvas modes.
  2. *Bento Grid*: Modern modular card hierarchy grouping roles, skills, and projects.
  3. *Notion Document*: Clean workspace document aesthetic with breadcrumbs and toggles.
  4. *Retro Terminal*: CRT command-line interface with interactive terminal prompt.
  5. *Glassmorphic*: Frosted-glass backdrop blur with glowing neon gradients.
  6. *Neumorphic*: Soft tactile shadows, clean embossed card architecture.
  7. *Executive*: Formal corporate layout crafted for engineering managers and architects.
  8. *Creative*: Vibrant expressive layout with colorful tags and bold headings.
  9. *Split View*: Fixed bio left sidebar with independently scrolling experience feed.
  10. *Interactive Timeline*: Chronological milestone timeline of career achievements.
- **AI Customizer Chatbox (Pro Tier)**: Natural language visual tuning allowing users to adjust color palettes, typography, headline styling, and resume bio refinements using plain text prompts.
- **1-Click WhatsApp Direct Contact**: Embedded direct messaging button for instant recruiter outreach.
- **Global Edge CDN Hosting**: Every portfolio gets a shareable public URL at `/p/username/id` hosted with sub-50ms latency.
- **Automated Technical SEO & Schema**: Pre-configured `schema.org/Person`, `schema.org/ProfilePage`, and `BreadcrumbList` JSON-LD rich snippets with complete OpenGraph social share cards.

## Pricing Plans
- **Free Starter (₹0 / forever)**:
  - 2 Classic Templates (Minimal & Terminal)
  - Instant AI Resume OCR & Extraction
  - Dark & Light Canvas Modes
  - Shareable Public URL (`/p/username/id`)
  - Unlimited Profile Visits
- **Lite Creator (₹19 / year)**:
  - 6 Dynamic Templates (Bento Grid, Creative, Executive, Split View, Minimal, Terminal)
  - WhatsApp Direct Recruiter Contact Button
  - Priority Global Edge CDN Hosting
  - Google SEO Schema & Rich Snippets
- **Pro Visionary (₹29 / year)**:
  - Full Access to All 10 Designer Templates
  - AI Customizer Chatbox (Natural Language Styling & Bio Refinement)
  - Custom Color & Typography Palette Tuning
  - Verified Pro Badge on Live Public Link
  - Google Drive Document Sync

## Security & Data Governance
- Zero third-party data selling or monetization of resume contents.
- Portfolios can be updated or deleted instantly with permanent immediate link expiration.
- Secure JWT authentication and automated HTTPS encryption.
